gloss: to make; to prepare; to create

definitions.gloss: to make; to prepare; to create
definitions.explanation: To make or prepare something, often by hand or with care. Has a somewhat traditional or literary feel.
To create something fictitious such as an excuse or story.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}が{弁当|べんとう}を{拵|こしら}えてくれた。
examples.english: My mother made me a bento.

examples.japanese: {言|い}い{訳|わけ}を{拵|こしら}えるな。
{手作|てづく}りで{人形|にんぎょう}を{拵|こしら}える。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
Pattern: Xを{拵|こしら}える

ASPECT (ている):
{拵|こしら}えている indicates ongoing action (in the process of making).

REGISTER:
Slightly literary or old-fashioned. More commonly used in written language or by older speakers. {作|つく}る is the neutral everyday equivalent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{料理|りょうり}を{拵|こしら}える - to prepare a meal
・{言|い}い{訳|わけ}を{拵|こしら}える - to make up an excuse
・{話|はなし}を{拵|こしら}える - to fabricate a story

NUANCE:
Compared to {作|つく}る, {拵|こしら}える suggests more care, craftsmanship, or a traditional approach. Often used for food preparation and handmade items.
